quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year April 2025 - March 2026 (IFRS): revenue JPY 5,894.7 billion (up JPY 373.0 billion from JPY 5,521.7 billion), on the weaker yen and price improvements; operating profit JPY 433.0 billion (up JPY 41.2 billion), with every segment improving; operating margin 7.3% (up 0.2 points); profit before tax JPY 526.0 billion; net profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 407.7 billion (up JPY 83.6 billion); ROE 9.7%. quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor & Device segment, fiscal year to March 2026: management states demand for power semiconductors stayed stagnant while demand for optical devices for communications remained firm. quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term management strategy (the company names fiscal years by the year they start: its fiscal 2025 is April 2025 - March 2026): the company states it met every target of its plan through fiscal 2025 (revenue JPY 5 trillion+, operating margin 8%+, ROE 9%, cash generation JPY 3.3 trillion over fiscal 2021-2025), with fiscal 2025 revenue JPY 5,894.7 billion, operating margin 9.1% (excluding the impact of special measures under its Next Stage support program), ROE 9.7% and cash generation JPY 3.4 trillion. Its fiscal 2030 targets (all excluding the automotive equipment business): adjusted operating margin 12%+ (8.5% in fiscal 2025), ROE 12%, and revenue growth of 3-5% over fiscal 2025-2030. Segment strategy: in Infrastructure, focus resources on data-center-related businesses, decarbonization components and defense / space; in Semiconductor & Device, optimize the power-device portfolio and strengthen market leadership in optical devices while sharply improving capital efficiency.
quarterly_data.figure: company's fiscal 2030 targets: adjusted operating margin 12%+; ROE 12%; revenue growth 3-5% (fiscal 2025-2030)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure in the fiscal year to March 2026 was JPY 310,746 million, of which Semiconductor & Device JPY 105,131 million, mainly to increase power-device production. Planned capex for the following year (new builds and expansion) is JPY 310,000 million, including Semiconductor & Device JPY 67,000 million (power-device capacity increase), Infrastructure JPY 60,000 million (more defense / space and power equipment output), Life JPY 80,000 million and Industry & Mobility JPY 52,000 million. The Power Device Works Kumamoto Shisui factory (semiconductor production equipment) carried a book value of JPY 83,275 million at year end.
quarterly_data.figure: capex JPY 310,746 million (Semiconductor & Device JPY 105,131 million); next-year plan JPY 310,000 million (Semiconductor & Device JPY 67,000 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D: the group developed packaging technology for co-packaged optics for next-generation data centers, replacing electrical connections inside equipment with optical ones - electrical components and optical devices are mounted with flip-chip technology instead of wire bonding, which the company expects to deliver the high bandwidth edge density co-packaged optics require; it will continue developing next-generation opto-electronic integration to raise data-center capacity and cut power.

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D spending in the fiscal year to March 2026 was JPY 235.9 billion (103% of the prior year), of which Semiconductor & Device JPY 19.2 billion (power devices; optical devices for data centers and fiber-optic communications; high-frequency devices for 5G, satellite communications and radar). Results include the HVIGBT module XB series (3.3kV and 4.5kV power semiconductors for railway and other large industrial inverters) with about 20 times the humidity resistance of earlier products and lower switching losses (about 15% for the 3.3kV type, about 5% for the 4.5kV type).
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 235.9 billion (103%); Semiconductor & Device R&D JPY 19.2 billion
